title: A v1 Chief of Staff session is imported

steps.why: fleet-switchboard import-v1: v1's export converted, checked against v2's schema, then imported; a person then opens the TUI on the new session (the runbook's step)

expect.name: same-messages
expect.why: v2 holds one message per v1 message, in the same order, with the same timestamps and typed text

expect.name: fleet-metadata
expect.why: session.get returns the stamped metadata.fleet, including where it came from

expect.name: ask-2-listed
expect.why: `intents`, run in the imported agent's pane, lists the open asks under every orchestrator's charter
